summary: Request: safe live rollback helper and drain script after enabling runtime autothrottle + quant profile
description:
Issue summary:
ClearSight Health reports a sudden throughput inversion and elevated 5xxs after enabling a new runtime 'autothrottle' feature together with an experimental quantization profile across a subset of their routes. They enabled the change yesterday (2026-03-09 21:00 UTC) in the dedicated pool.

Impact:
- Customer-facing latency P95 doubled from ~120ms to ~260ms on high-concurrency routes.
- 5xx rate increased from ~0.1% to 1.9% for model gptj-13b-quantized.
- Token cost per request spiked due to re-tries and backpressure.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool: clearSight-pool-3 (US-EAST).
- Routes affected: /v1/generate/clin-notes (pinned to gptj-13b-quantized), /v1/chat/assist (redwood-open-7b).
- Config changes: autothrottle: enabled (window=60s, target-latency=100ms), batch_policy: cross-tenant-burst=on, quant_profile: aggressive-v2 applied to tenant CS-987.

Customer request:
- They asked for a safe, low-latency rollback path that preserves session consistency and avoids global traffic drops. Prefer a per-tenant graceful unwind script and recommended telemetry checks before/after toggles.

Observed artifacts (logs/metrics):
- Spike timeline: 2026-03-09 21:15 UTC peak 5xx -> 21:40 UTC sustained elevated errors.
- Sample peer log (router): "WARN: backpressure applied: shedding 12% traffic for tenant CS-987 due to token queue depth".
- Pod logs (worker-5): "kv-evict triggered during quant switch; cache-miss rate +420%".
- Trace snippets show repeated cold-start of KV cache and elevated serialization latencies when quant profile changed.

Expected behavior:
- Autothrottle should cap throughput without causing crash loops or cache thrash; quant profile changes should be staged with KV cache rehydrate window.

Notes:
- Customer has high-concurrency short requests (interactive UI). Minimizing user-visible latency is their top priority.
- They do not want a full shutdown of the dedicated pool; prefer traffic gating + per-tenant demotion to previous profile.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Tenant applies 'aggressive-v2' quant_profile and enables autothrottle with cross-tenant batching in dedicated pool.
2) Observe increased KV evictions and raised per-request latency under 50-100 concurrent connections.
3) Errors escalate as backpressure heuristics begin shedding tenant traffic.

(We reproduced on staging with smaller pool and high concurrency harness.)
investigation_notes: 03/10 02:10 UTC - Confirmed config change in customer config: quant_profile=aggressive-v2 + autothrottle enabled. Verified via tenant config snapshot (S3).

03/10 03:05 UTC - Metric correlation: kv_cache_miss_rate and worker_cpu show strong correlation with 5xx spikes. Hypothesis: quant profile increases working set causing frequent KV eviction; autothrottle then triggers burst-shedding loops.

03/10 05:20 UTC - Reproduced locally: enabling aggressive-v2 on gptj-13b-quantized with cross-tenant batching at QPS 600 causes cache warmup thrash and request timeouts. Setting batch window to 8ms reduced thrash but increased cost.

Suspected cause: interaction between aggressive quantized model memory footprint and cross-tenant continuous batching causing cache churn and elevated latency, which then trips autothrottle's shedding threshold creating a feedback loop.
customer_workarounds_attempted: Customer manually disabled cross-tenant-burst in route config; observed partial latency improvement but still elevated 5xxs.
They attempted to roll back quant_profile via console but rollouts failed due to ongoing traffic gating.
proposed_action_plan: 1) Apply per-tenant graceful demote: toggle tenant CS-987 quant_profile back to 'moderate-v1' with drain-window=300s and snapshot snapshot-id from 2026-03-09-20:50 (preserves pinned routes).

2) Run traffic gating script (safe-drain.sh) which: a) creates a per-route shadow redirect to healthy replica set, b) reduces concurrency cap for tenant to 25% of current, c) waits for in-flight sessions to complete with 5-minute drain window, d) flips profile flag in config-store.
3) Monitor key telemetry: p95_latency, kv_cache_miss_rate, worker_error_rate, model_load_count. Abort and revert if any of: p95 > pre-change p95 + 100ms after 10 minutes, 5xx rate > 1%.
4) If step 2 fails, perform fast fallback: disable autothrottle for the tenant and route to a non-quantized variant (redwood-open-7b) for 10 minutes while team investigates memory/eviction behavior.
5) Post-mortem: capture heap/KV cache profiles, add preflight sim to optimizer rollout pipeline to detect working-set regressions.
script_snippet:
#!/bin/bash
# safe-drain.sh (prototype)
TENANT=CS-987
DRAIN=300
# 1) set route concurrency cap
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/tenants/${TENANT}/config -d '{\"concurrency_cap\":0.25}'
# 2) flip profile after wait
sleep 30
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/tenants/${TENANT}/config -d '{\"quant_profile\":\"moderate-v1\"}'
# 3) wait for drain window
sleep ${DRAIN}
# 4) validate basic health
# (run metric checks via internal monitoring CLI)
comments: Sophie Campbell (Support): Opened ticket with customer's request and provided initial artifacts and logs.
Daniel Ortega (Assigned SRE): Running a staged rehydrate simulation in staging; planning to run safe-drain script during customer's low-traffic window (03/12 02:00 UTC).
Customer (ClearSight): Prefers no full pool restarts. Agrees to a 5-minute drain window and per-route gating. Will provide start/stop approval in Slack #support-clearsight.
Daniel Ortega: Flagging for runtime engineer pair (cc @Maya Singh) to watch model load side-effects during demote.
resolution_notes: In Progress - awaiting scheduled window with customer (03/12 02:00 UTC). Prepared safe-drain script and rollback checklist. If rollback completes successfully, draft post-incident actions: add quant-profile preflight, add KV cache warmup hook, and limit cross-tenant batching for quantized models.
follow_up_actions: Schedule joint runbook drill with ClearSight (runbook link attached).
Add optimizer preflight test to CI (simulate tenant working set at QPS 2x baseline).
Create a console toggle that performs atomic per-tenant demote with built-in telemetry gates.
